Cue: acme release notes command fails with error E42
Text: Add the --since-tag none flag to the acme release notes command to avoid the error.

Failed:
```
error: E42
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./bin/acme release notes --since-tag none","timeout":30}
```

Cue: Make test fails with 'workspace not initialised'
Text: Run 'make bootstrap' before 'make test' to initialise the workspace.

Failed:
```
FATAL: workspace not initialised (E17)
make: *** [Makefile:3: test] Error 2
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"cd /tmp/gain-test-1-6b56_z2e \u0026\u0026 make bootstrap \u0026\u0026 make test"}
```

Cue: migrate.sh requires database configuration
Text: Include the --db flag with the appropriate database path (e.g., sqlite:./dev.db) in the command.

Failed:
```
error: no database configured; pass --db sqlite:./dev.db
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./scripts/migrate.sh status --db sqlite:./dev.db","timeout":30}
```

Cue: Calling a build tool that requires a profile
Text: Always include the --profile argument with a value of dev or prod.

Failed:
```
error: --profile is required (dev|prod)
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./bin/acme build --profile dev 2\u003e\u00261"}
```
